contentBlocks.body: A union type, written A | B, says a value is one of several types. It is perfect for a fixed set of options, like a status that is only ever "core" or "pro".

knowledgeItems.prompt: What does the type Plan = "core" | "pro" allow?

payload.explanation: A string-literal union restricts the value to the listed options.

payload.text: A union type separates its alternatives with the ____ symbol.
